claims.statement: The backend exposes distinct domain, application/runtime, infrastructure adapter, API, worker, demo, security, and test homes; the duplicate top-level adapter package is absent, the safe-profile registry is owned by infrastructure/adapters, and internal plus third-party dependency ownership remains fail-closed under the declared policy.

Catalog hierarchy DTO ownership resides in src/contracts, response normalization and transport reside in src/api, and org-chart model/normalizer modules are inward-only compatibility re-exports; API modules do not depend outward on feature modules and UI modules do not own transport paths or direct fetch calls.
test_refs: apps/web/config/arch08FrontendBoundaries.test.ts::ARCH-08 keeps production UI, API, contracts, and tests directionally separated

claims.statement: The dependency-free repository checker and focused negative fixtures reject missing layer homes, the legacy adapter home, forbidden Python layer/API-ORM/test imports, unapproved third-party frameworks or SDKs, impure frontend contracts, API-to-feature imports, production-to-test imports, and direct UI fetch or API-path ownership; new unlisted edges fail closed.

The dependency-free repository checker remains a prerequisite of the governance CI path and the TypeScript architecture suite remains a prerequisite of the web CI path, so later requirement branches continuously re-evaluate both layer contracts.

limitations: The boundary gates perform static path/import/source analysis, including quoted literal dynamic imports. They do not prove runtime side effects, computed dynamic import or reflection behavior, dependency-injection composition, or deployed topology.

Existing intentional composition roots and cross-layer seams are enumerated narrowly in architecture-boundaries.json. ARCH-08 rejects new unlisted edges but does not refactor demo execution, catalog query composition, or other already reviewed composition wiring.

The frontend catalog contract is the normalized UI-facing hierarchy contract, with compatibility re-exports preserving existing consumers. ARCH-08 does not claim a completed generated OpenAPI client or elimination of every manually normalized frontend DTO.

The TypeScript/Vitest boundary test uses the installed pinned frontend toolchain; the Python checker remains dependency-free and is the causal witness. Neither gate is a browser or end-to-end behavior claim.

verify-architecture is wired into the existing verify-governance CI path and the focused frontend gate into verify-web. The final make verify and verify-clean aggregates remain DEL-07 and DEL-05 responsibilities.
